get.summary: Removes playlist placements from a folder or the root.
get.description: OpenSubsonic extension name `playlistFolders` (as returned by `getOpenSubsonicExtensions`). Removes placements from the authenticated user's playlist organization: unfiles each given playlist from the given folder (or removes its explicit root placement) without touching the playlist's other placements. Removing a playlist's last placement returns it to the implicit root. Removing a placement that does not exist is not an error (idempotent). Never modifies the playlists themselves.

parameters.name: playlistId
parameters.description: ID of the playlist to unfile. Multiple parameters allowed.

parameters.name: playlistFolderId
parameters.description: ID of the folder to remove the playlists from. An empty or omitted value removes explicit root placements.

post.summary: Removes playlist placements from a folder or the root.

Removing a playlist's last placement returns it to the implicit root. Removing a placement that does not exist is not an error (idempotent). Never modifies the playlists themselves.
